name: Establishment of the "Pale of Settlement" (1791) (C0036)

techniques.comment: The introduction of territorial discrimination: by the decree of 1791, the Jewish population's right to burgher and merchant status was confined to specific viceroyalties – Ekaterinoslav and Taurida(Citation: Указ о правах гражданства евреев 1791) – the legal foundation of the future Pale of Settlement, which confined the area of residence and economic activity to the colonized governorates.
